cues.text: I'm building software whose entire interface is driven by AI.
Click the image. Add your words. The interface redraws around your intent.
These are actual outputs from a model trained from random weights.
It reads the whole frame, then chooses a local edit or a full redraw.
Here, only the chat changes. Everything outside the edit stays pixel-exact.
The agent saved this document, then read it back to verify the result.
One screen. Driven by AI. Built around your intent.
